2110095131265417436.en_summary: @KobeissiLetter says US consumer stocks are struggling: equal-weight consumer discretionary ETF $RSPD is down 8.0% YTD 2026 near its lowest since June 2025, while the S&P 500 is up 13.9% and just 0.3% below its all-time high, a 22-percentage-point gap. Weakening demand for autos, furniture and home-improvement, plus rising oil, elevated inflation and higher borrowing costs, are squeezing budgets; discretionary and staples earnings are expected to decline for the first time since end-2024.
